title: 第3章 废柴重生第4章 生死换脉
slug: 天神传说第438章改革开始
content_zh:
黑土森林。
“呼，呼，呼。”两随从放下麻袋，大口的喘着粗气。
“两个废物，连个麻袋都扛不动。”苏明又恢复了之前的趾高气昂。
“你怎么不扛着试试。”随从甲嘟囔着。
苏明瞪了他一眼，他瞬间便老实了。
“苏少卿啊，今天的一切，都怪你自己作死，可怨不得我啊。”苏明拍了拍麻袋，把玩着苏鸿章给苏少卿留的玄戒，里面有这些年苏少卿自己攒的一些护体丹，随后一把将麻袋拿起扔在前方的灌木丛里。
“你们两个，等一会回了城，继续在小院里给我蹲着。”苏明道。
“啊？苏少卿都死了，我们还回去干嘛。”随从乙道。
“等晚上苏桃儿回来，你们把他抓到我常去的那个客栈里面，懂了吗。”苏明脸上露出一抹猥琐的笑容。
“哦～～放心苏护卫，我们一定办到。”
三人笑着离开这里，却没看到一束耀眼白光以极快的速度从天上落入到灌木丛中。
一片虚无之地。
白涛茫然的从一片迷雾中醒来。
“这是哪，地府吗，怎么这么大一片雾。”白涛站起身，环顾着四周。
“我的伤，没了。”白涛没有感觉到头上的疼痛。
“喂！有人吗！”
声音回荡在这片虚无之地，可过了好久也不见人回应。
白涛就这样走了好久，好久，直到一条河边。
“有人吗——”白涛喊道。
还是无人回应。

“夜半三更鬼门开，阎王唤尔五更来。奈何桥头今犹在，不见当年孟婆来。呵呵呵呵，又来人了……”
一条船不知从何处缓缓飘来，奇怪的是那撑船的人却穿着一身的黑斗篷，外表看上去瘦瘦的，白涛感觉，这根本不是一个人能瘦到的地步，骨架倒是差不多。
“你好，请问这里是什么地方。”白涛壮着胆子问道。
“上船。”骨架子道。
白涛一脸疑惑的看着这骨架子。
“上船。”骨架子语气有些催促。
白涛鼓足勇气，慢慢的走上船。
骨架子滑动船杆，船慢慢的向前走着。
“额，这位……爷爷，您要带我去哪。”白涛问道。
“呵呵呵呵，你不是已经死了吗，我还能带你去哪。”骨架子回头看向白涛，白涛惊讶的发现这竟然真的是一具骨架！
白涛转头看见岸边正开放着一朵极其妖艳的花。
“彼岸花！”白涛惊道：“这是奈河！”
白涛想要下船，可水中那呼之欲出的鬼爪让白涛胆战心惊。
“坐稳了，要过桥了。”骨架子发出一阵阴森的笑声。
轰！
一道闪电划过天空。
骨架子停了下来。
“你，还没死。”骨架子看了看天空道。
content_en:
Black soil forest.
"Hoo, ho, ho." The two attendants put down their sacks and gasped for air.
"Two losers, they can't even carry a sack." Su Ming returned to his previous arrogance.
"Why don't you try carrying it." Follower A muttered.
Su Ming glared at him, and he immediately became honest.
"Su Shaoqing, everything today is your fault for committing suicide, but you can't blame me." Su Ming patted the sack and played with the mysterious ring that Su Hongzhang left for Su Shaoqing. It contained some protective pills that Su Shaoqing had accumulated over the years. Then he picked up the sack and threw it into the bushes in front of him.
"You two, when you return to the city later, continue squatting for me in the small courtyard." Su Ming said.
"Ah? Su Shaoqing is dead, why should we go back?" Follower B said.
"When Su Tao'er comes back in the evening, you can catch him in the inn where I often go. Do you understand?" Su Ming had a lewd smile on his face.
"Oh~~ Don't worry, Guard Su, we will definitely do it."
The three of them left here with a smile, but they did not see a beam of dazzling white light falling from the sky into the bushes at an extremely fast speed.
A land of nothingness.
Bai Tao woke up from a fog in confusion.
"Where is this, the underworld? Why is there such a fog?" Bai Tao stood up and looked around.
"My injury is gone." Bai Tao didn't feel the pain on his head.
"Hey! Is there anyone there?"
The voice echoed in this land of nothingness, but no one responded after a long time.
Bai Tao walked like this for a long time until he reached a river.
"Is there anyone here?" Bai Tao shouted.
Still no one responded.
"The ghost gate opens at midnight, and the King of Hell calls you to come at the fifth watch. However, the bridge is still there today, and I don't see Po Meng coming back then. Hahahaha, someone is here again..."
A boat floated slowly from nowhere. What was strange was that the man supporting the boat was wearing a black cloak and looked thin. Bai Tao felt that this was not how thin a person could be, but his frame was about the same.
"Hello, may I ask where this place is?" Bai Tao asked bravely.
"Get on the boat." Jiaozi said.
Bai Tao looked at the skeleton with a puzzled look.
"Get on the boat." Jiaozizi's tone was urging.
Bai Tao mustered up his courage and slowly walked onto the boat.
The skeleton slides the boat pole, and the boat moves forward slowly.
"Um, Grandpa, where are you taking me?" Bai Tao asked.
"Hehehehe, aren't you already dead? Where else can I take you?" Jiaozizi looked back at Bai Tao. Bai Tao was surprised to find that this was really a skeleton!
Bai Tao turned around and saw an extremely coquettish flower blooming on the shore.
"Bianganhua!" Bai Tao exclaimed in surprise: "This is Naihe!"
Bai Tao wanted to get off the boat, but the ghost claws that were about to come out in the water made Bai Tao frightened.
"Sit tight, we're about to cross the bridge." Jiaozi let out a sinister laugh.
boom!
A bolt of lightning flashed across the sky.
The skeleton stopped.
"You're not dead yet." Jiaozi looked at the sky and said.
